title: Electrochemical corrosion behavior of α-titanium alloys in simulated biological environments (comparative study)
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38110-38119
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05869K, Paper
Open Access

Hala Hrir, Omar Ait Layachi, Abderrazzak Boudouma, Abdeslam El Bouari, Abdelaziz Ait Sidimou, Mohssine El Marrakchi, Elmati Khoumri
This study examines the electrochemical behavior of titanium alloys in simulated physiological solutions using OCP, PPC, EIS, SEM, EDS, and AFM to highlight biomolecule adsorption and TiO2 degradation in the presence of H2O2.
